title: Chrome Variations input validation can permit code execution outside the sandbox
summary: Google identifies CVE-2026-134401 as improper input validation in Chrome Variations. A remote attacker could potentially execute code outside the sandbox through crafted HTML. Google released fixes for desktop Stable and Windows/macOS Extended Stable.

severity.rationale: Crafted web content can potentially execute code outside the browser sandbox. Agents routinely load untrusted pages without a person reviewing each page, so this meets the critical threshold for agent browsing.

vendor_severity.source: Google Chrome Releases and Google CNA

affected.note: Google lists Stable 158.0.8127.88/.89 for Windows and Mac and 158.0.8127.88 for Linux. The CNA describes Chrome before 158.0.8127.88 as affected.
Google lists this security fix in Extended Stable 156.0.8078.114 for Windows and Mac. This is a separate channel threshold.

exposure: Chrome processing untrusted HTML is exposed, including agent-driven browsing with the sandbox enabled. Browsers used only against trusted applications have lower exposure. Other Chromium-derived products need their own vendor fix mappings.

params.instructions: Read the browser executable version and release channel. Chrome Stable needs 158.0.8127.88 or later; Windows/macOS Extended Stable needs 156.0.8078.114 or later. Check derived browsers against their own vendor advisories.

remediation.action: Update Chrome for its release channel
remediation.details: Install the patched Stable or Extended Stable release listed for the platform, then restart browser processes. Evaluate other channels and Chromium-derived products using their vendor fix mappings.
remediation.risk: Medium. Restarting the browser interrupts active automation; check workflow compatibility after updating.

verification: Read the version from the executable actually used by automation and compare it with the fixed version for that channel.
After restarting browser processes, run a harmless browsing workflow to check compatibility.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted from directly inspected Google release notices and the Google CNA CVE record for independent review.
